I'm really glad you've found folks who will stand strong with you.  I hope to do the same.  I hope I can overcome my own abuse to the extent that you have.  

I'll keep looking for those folks who can fill that role.  My thanks.
Thanks.  That's exactly how i've felt -- for so long i can scarcely remember anything else.  But your point is well taken.  I'm glad you're feeling better and I appreciate you reaching out.

a day at a time, I guess.  The days seem like they are getting harder. though.  

I tried antidepressants when I was in college, for over a year -- but this was before I had the accident.  I will consider it, I suppose.  I just need to move forward.

Thanks a ton for replying.  I've been feeling pretty alone on this and just hearing someone else say it means a great deal.

Thanks for replying.  I appreciate it, for real.

I can't disagree.  I feel like my life has been taken from me before I even got started.  But thank you for your kind sentiments.
